purpose: E167 fused E65 correlation-logSPD with raw log band power and reached diagnostic AUC 0.7999, but W never exceeded 0.6997 because raw logbp has poor Train LOSO separability (0.4103 at acceptance 0.90 vs E65 0.8412): its absolute log power mixes in a session-level amplitude offset. E165 showed E65 discards amplitude (channel gain / band gain / shift invariant). This run builds amplitude-scale-free spectral SHAPE features from the cached log band power (per-channel band profile, slope over band centres, band ratios, channel-relative power) and asks whether the shape family keeps logbp's ranking gain while restoring LOSO rejection, so W can pass 0.6997 / 0.7164.

logbp_layout.stored_order: E146 writes log band power as power.permute(0,2,1).reshape(B, C*NB), i.e. column index = channel*5 + band (CHANNEL-major, not band-major). Verified empirically: columns c*5 .. c*5+4 are the 5 bands of one channel and decrease monotonically delta>theta>alpha>beta>gamma.

E65_logspd.note: 855-d correlation log-SPD vector, the E143 representation

logbp.note: 90-d raw log band power control (E148 / E167 reference)

profile.definition: per channel softmax over the 5 bands of log power (subtract max, exp, normalise) -> 5-d spectral profile, 18 channels x 5 = 90
profile.invariance: invariant to any per-channel multiplicative gain (additive offset in log power), hence session amplitude offsets cancel

slope.definition: per channel OLS slope of the 5 log band powers against the band geometric centre frequency sqrt(lo*hi) Hz -> 18

ratios.definition: per channel log-band ratios theta/alpha, beta/alpha, gamma/alpha, low/high where low/high = mean(delta,theta) - mean(alpha,beta,gamma) -> 18 x 4 = 72
ratios.invariance: differences of log powers, invariant to per-channel additive offset (gain)

relpower.definition: per channel total log power (logsumexp over the 5 bands) minus the trial mean over the 18 channels -> 18
relpower.invariance: invariant to a trial-global amplitude offset, keeps only the channel-relative power pattern

evaluation.grid: per family: task-wise z-score (Train statistics) -> PCA over {16, 32, 48, native dim} -> prototype k in {1, 3, 6, 12}
evaluation.pca_dim_rule: dims above a family's native dimensionality are clipped to that native dim (slope/relpower native 18 -> {16,18}; ratios native 72 -> {16,32,48,72}; profile native 90 -> {16,32,48,90}); 96 > 90 is therefore the native 90 for profile/logbp
evaluation.train_oof: 5 contiguous frac blocks (prototypes rebuilt without the held block)
evaluation.loso: per fold: prototypes from fit_rows (frac<=0.6) of the 19 enrolled identities only, evaluation block 0.6<frac<=0.8
evaluation.threshold: quantile of the 5-block Train OOF score at each acceptance rate; LOSO uses the per-fold known-block quantile
evaluation.test: scored once; session labels used only for the post-hoc diagnostic AUC

fusion.block_norm: each PCA block divided by its Train fit_rows RMS so both blocks carry equal total variance

E148_logbp_P.note: E167 reproduced 0.7772 with the same probe

ceiling_analysis.method: E159: freeze the configuration's OOF/Test score, sweep the threshold over 2000 quantiles of the pooled Train-OOF + Test score distribution, and record (acceptance, LOSO rejection, S1 rejection, S2 acceptance, W) at every point.
ceiling_analysis.oracle_max_W: max W along the full threshold sweep, taking the LOSO rejection achieved exactly at each threshold
ceiling_analysis.optimistic_bound: LOSO fixed at the configuration's own maximum LOSO rejection over the protocol acceptance grid [0.80, 0.96]; the Test operating point is free
ceiling_analysis.also_reported: the full-sweep LOSO maximum variant and the point where S1 rejection is closest to 0.80

reporting.test_official: N/A: the Test split has no public labels; session labels are used only for the diagnostic AUC after scoring
